facts.title: the mill not turning before winter

text.precise: De Zwaan won't turn again before winter. Harmen can't pay for new sailcloth, and nobody will lend it him.
text.village: The mill won't turn again before winter, they say.
text.far: The mill at Molenend is finished, they say.

text.precise: A stranger from Graafhaven came to Veenhoek on Dinsdag, in the evening.
text.village: There's a stranger about in Veenhoek, come from Graafhaven.
text.far: A stranger has come to the Holleveen, they say.

facts.title: the dyke broke at Oude Zijl

text.precise: The dyke at Oude Zijl broke in the night and the water ran into Veenhoek.
text.village: The dyke's gone at Oude Zijl! The water's in Veenhoek, run for the high ground!
text.far: A dyke broke in the Holleveen and a village went under.

text.precise: Wouter lost his knife somewhere near The Stable Yard and is looking everywhere for it.
text.far: Someone in The Drowned Goose lost a knife, they say.

facts.title: Aaltje and Wendela met at The Waagdam Road

text.precise: Aaltje and Wendela ran into each other at The Waagdam Road, and words were had.
text.village: Aaltje and Wendela had words at The Waagdam Road, they say.
text.far: Two old enemies met on the road.

text.precise: Harmen needs 2 bolts of sailcloth and doesn't know where to get them.
text.village: Harmen is looking for bolts of sailcloth.
text.far: Someone in Molenend is looking for bolts of sailcloth, they say.
